sources.title: Guidelines for Embedding Metadata in Broadcast WAVE Files
sources.version_or_commit: FADGI Audio-Visual Working Group Version 3, approved 2021-04-26; static PDF
sources.locator: PDF pp. 6–10 for BEXT fields/lengths, OriginationDate and version-reader exceptions; p. 26 for Code Page/CSET default
sources.observed_operation: Opened official PDF and searched/opened CSET and ISO 8859/1 passages in browser.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: FADGI labels individual elements strongly recommended, recommended or optional; it sets bounded lengths. For internal metadata code page, absent/zero CSET means ISO 8859/1. OriginationDate describes archival-entity-local file-creation date.
sources.applicability: Directly governs conditions for a proposed BWF metadata subset; does not require embedding in received originals or prove support in other applications.
sources.limitations: 2021 guideline; no volunteer file or cross-application round trip examined by reviewer.

sources.title: Broadcast WAVE Audio File Format, Version 1 (Library of Congress Sustainability of Digital Formats)
sources.version_or_commit: LoC FDD fdd000356; page reports last significant update 2024-04-23
sources.locator: Accessibility Features / ltxt at page lines 64–65; fidelity and rendering at lines 70–76; structure and chunks in Description/Notes
sources.observed_operation: Opened official page and searched for Labeled Text; observed the transcript chunk and screen-reader qualification, plus codec-dependent fidelity.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: BWF can carry transcription/caption text in ltxt; that text is not necessarily structured or tagged for screen readers. Fidelity depends on encoding; BWF metadata support is not identical to ordinary rendering support.
sources.applicability: Supports keeping a separately accessible transcript and inspecting actual codec/metadata behavior.
sources.limitations: Format description, not a test of this society's readers or rewrite chain.

sources.title: BWF MetaEdit GUI release history
sources.version_or_commit: History file on mutable master; commit hash not exposed (UNKNOWN). Relevant entries: 20.05 (2020-05-28), 20.08 (2020-08-11), 23.04 (2023-04-10), 25.04 (2025-04-30). Current top entry observed: 26.08 (2026-08-27), unrelated to this encoding point.
sources.observed_operation: Opened official raw history file and searched version entries; inspected linked GitHub history rendering as corroboration.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: 20.05 says Improve ASCII support (Issue #29, #63); 23.04 adds listed legacy encodings and CSET read/write; 25.04 adds ISO8859-1 fallback for reading core file. Release notes show targeted changes, not universal or end-to-end inter-tool success.
sources.applicability: Material historical evidence for the exact encoding issue and why a pinned chain should be round-trip tested.
sources.limitations: Mutable branch; explicit issue reference links the 20.05 change to #29 but does not establish every reporter case is fixed in every path.

sources.title: BWF MetaEdit issue #29: non 7-bit ASCII

sources.title: RFC 8493 — The BagIt File Packaging Format (V1.0)
sources.locator: §2.1.2–2.1.3 payload and payload manifest; §2.2.1 tag manifest; §2.3–2.4 text/tag and checksum rules; §3 validity
sources.observed_operation: Opened RFC Editor canonical page (redirected to RFC info view); inspected lines defining opaque payload, complete payload manifest, tag manifests, and checksum validation.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: BagIt requires data/ and a payload manifest listing every payload file. A tag manifest is optional and lists tag files. UTF-8 is strongly recommended for text tag files; payload manifest does not cover files outside data/.
sources.applicability: Directly determines whether authoritative sidecars are covered by the proposed package fixity approach.
sources.limitations: Specifies package integrity mechanics, not descriptive correctness, consent, redundant storage, or ongoing fixity policy.

sources.title: PREMIS Data Dictionary for Preservation Metadata, Version 3.0
sources.version_or_commit: PREMIS Data Dictionary v3.0; official LoC full PDF updated November 2015
sources.locator: Official landing page; PDF introduction pp. 15–16/semantic units 1.13 and Event sections; derivation relationship and Event timestamp; landing page data model entities
sources.observed_operation: Opened official LoC version page, followed its v3.0 PDF link, and searched the PDF for relationship, derivation, and event outcome/date passages.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: PREMIS models Objects, Events, Rights, and Agents; derivation relationships can link objects and the creating Event/date. It is flexible, and the draft's compact log is an analogy rather than PREMIS conformance.
sources.applicability: Supports stable object/derivative and event-history concepts for the pilot.
sources.limitations: Full PREMIS adoption is not required; no schema or repository was implemented.

sources.title: Transcribing Interviews — Veterans History Project, Library of Congress

sources.observed_operation: Direct open returned an internal retrieval error; an official-domain search result returned extensive page text. No direct line inspection succeeded.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: VHP says transcripts are welcome but not required; identifies transcriber/editor/date and asks that changes be shown. Retrieved text calls a transcript an access/reference substitute for a recording, not a preservation-master substitute.
